evidence.summary: Nanjing University holds a secrecy qualification: in 2012 its secrecy office reported the on-site review for renewing the qualification certificate, and in 2017 the university began its third round of secrecy-qualification certification.

Its rules on the secrecy of science and technology put its Institute of Advanced Technology in charge of the secrecy of the university’s defence research projects, including security and secrecy in weapons and equipment research and production.
